hook.en: A popular IPO is often subscribed many times over. The company cannot give everyone what they asked for. What happens to the extra application money?
hook.kn: ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ IPO ಹಲವು ಪಟ್ಟು ಅಧಿಕ ಚಂದಾ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕೇಳಿದಷ್ಟು ಕೊಡಲಾಗದು. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಣ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ?

objectives.en: Calculate excess application money and its adjustment

narration.en: A popular IPO is often subscribed many times over. The company cannot give everyone what they asked for. What happens to the extra application money? It is refunded, or adjusted towards allotment and calls.
narration.kn: ಜನಪ್ರಿಯ IPO ಹಲವು ಪಟ್ಟು ಅಧಿಕ ಚಂದಾ ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕೇಳಿದಷ್ಟು ಕೊಡಲಾಗದು. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಣ ಏನಾಗುತ್ತದೆ? ಅದನ್ನು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕರೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: The directors may (i) accept some applications in full and reject the rest, refunding their money; (ii) allot pro-rata to all applicants; or (iii) combine the two. In pro-rata allotment, the excess application money is adjusted towards allotment (and calls, if the articles permit) and any balance is refunded.
body.kn: ನಿರ್ದೇಶಕರು (i) ಕೆಲವು ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿ ಉಳಿದವನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಬಹುದು, (ii) ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅನುಪಾತಾನುಸಾರ ಹಂಚಬಹುದು, (iii) ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಸೇರಿಸಬಹುದು. ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ, ಉಳಿದುದನ್ನು ಹಿಂತಿರುಗಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A company offers 10,000 shares of ₹10 each: ₹3 on application, ₹4 on allotment, ₹3 on call. Applications are received for 15,000 shares and all applicants get shares pro-rata. Excess application money is adjusted on allotment. Find the cash received on allotment.

answer.en: ₹25,000 received on allotment (₹15,000 adjusted from application)

narration.en: Let us work this out together, step by step. A company offers 10,000 shares of ₹10 each: ₹3 on application, ₹4 on allotment, ₹3 on call. Applications are received for 15,000 shares and all applicants get shares pro-rata. Excess application money is adjusted on allotment. Find the cash received on allotment.

body.en: For one applicant: shares allotted = shares applied × pro-rata ratio. Excess = (applied − allotted) × application rate. Pay on allotment = allotted × allotment rate − excess.

narration.en: Per-applicant shortcut. For one applicant: shares allotted = shares applied × pro-rata ratio. Excess = (applied − allotted) × application rate. Pay on allotment = allotted × allotment rate − excess.
